preconditions.description: The number of books n must be at least 1 and at most 10^6 divided by m.
The length of each book title m must be at least 1 and at most 10^6 divided by n.

preconditions.expression: all(len(s) == m for s in strings)
preconditions.description: Each book title must have a length equal to m.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly n indices.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= output_indices[i] <= n for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: Each index in the output must be a valid index of the input strings.

postconditions.expression: all(output_indices[i] != output_indices[j] for i in range(n) for j in range(i + 1, n))
postconditions.description: All indices in the output must be distinct.
The output indices must be sorted according to the asc-desc-ending order of the corresponding book titles.

candidate_issues.instruction: Add a postcondition to ensure the sorting logic for asc-desc-ending order is correctly implemented.
candidate_issues.task_evidence: A string a occurs before a string b in asc-desc-ending order if and only if in the first position where a and b differ, the following holds: if it is an odd position, the string a has a letter that appears earlier in the alphabet than the corresponding letter in b; if it is an even position, the string a has a letter that appears later in the alphabet than the corresponding letter in b.
